whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Happy Hours,

I noticed your establishment has earned stellar 4.8★ reviews from 288+ customers near Kali Mandir in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new visitors.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, service menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/happyhours

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Happy Hours, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp table reservations, and your prime Mithapur location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact offerings aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
